integrity: Full permutation and independent bitboard enumerations, exact adjacency tables and all-source shortest paths are reproducible with included standard-library Python programs; independent scholarly validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Complete finite analysis only of nonattacking placements of eight queens on the standard eight-by-eight board under simultaneous reconfiguration; no n-parameter theorem, and no chess-legal sequential-move assertion. The cited 2009 survey and 2010 German genealogy article were not inspected in full, leaving a historical originality risk.
title: Five simultaneous queen changes are necessary and sufficient for eight-queen solution mobility
